releaseNotes: V1010 hardens the Web Commissioning Center snapshot endpoint so read-only presentation failures no longer surface as HTTP 500 and blank the page.

The snapshot no longer depends on CommissioningPresetRegistry.Instance; ICA-16DIO and ICA-SL preset rows are captured independently so one provider/catalog failure cannot poison all subsequent snapshot requests.

CTRL authority, Write Access, operation-busy state, device identity/display metadata, provider resolution and safety state are isolated independently; the endpoint returns a degraded but valid HTTP 200 JSON snapshot if any source is temporarily unavailable.

Snapshot JSON is serialized inside the endpoint with a final valid empty/degraded JSON fallback. Compare/Apply, pairing, CTRL/OBS authority, ISDU/PDO transport, Runtime, AI, HMI and V873 Light/Dark splash behavior are unchanged.

en: The Web Commissioning Center snapshot is now fail-open for read-only presentation: a transient catalog/runtime exception returns a valid degraded snapshot instead of HTTP 500.
ICA-16DIO and ICA-SL preset/device discovery are isolated independently; Compare/Apply and all write safety gates remain unchanged.
ko: Web 시운전 센터의 읽기 전용 Snapshot을 fail-open 구조로 변경하여 일시적인 카탈로그/런타임 예외가 발생해도 HTTP 500 대신 유효한 제한 상태 Snapshot을 반환합니다.
ICA-16DIO와 ICA-SL 프리셋/장치 검색을 서로 독립적으로 격리했으며 Compare/Apply 및 모든 쓰기 안전 게이트는 변경하지 않았습니다.
ja: Web コミッショニングセンターの読み取り専用 Snapshot を fail-open 化し、一時的なカタログ／ランタイム例外でも HTTP 500 ではなく有効な縮退 Snapshot を返すようにしました。
ICA-16DIO と ICA-SL のプリセット／デバイス検出を独立して分離し、Compare/Apply とすべての書き込み安全ゲートは変更していません。
zh-CN: Web 调试中心的只读 Snapshot 改为 fail-open 结构，即使出现临时目录/运行时异常，也会返回有效的降级 Snapshot，而不是 HTTP 500。
ICA-16DIO 与 ICA-SL 的预设/设备发现已分别隔离；Compare/Apply 以及所有写入安全门控均未更改。
de: Der schreibgeschützte Snapshot des Web-Inbetriebnahmezentrums arbeitet jetzt fail-open: temporäre Katalog-/Runtime-Fehler liefern einen gültigen degradierten Snapshot statt HTTP 500.
Die Preset-/Geräteerkennung für ICA-16DIO und ICA-SL ist unabhängig isoliert; Compare/Apply und alle Schreibschutz-Gates bleiben unverändert.
es: El Snapshot de solo lectura del Centro de Puesta en Marcha Web ahora es fail-open: una excepción temporal de catálogo/runtime devuelve un Snapshot degradado válido en lugar de HTTP 500.
El descubrimiento de presets/dispositivos ICA-16DIO e ICA-SL queda aislado de forma independiente; Compare/Apply y todas las protecciones de escritura permanecen sin cambios.
